name: Create or Update Contact
description: Create a contact in HubSpot, or update it when one with the same email already exists (enable **Update If Exists**). Put contact fields in **Object Properties** as HubSpot internal names. Example: Object Properties `{ "email": "ada@example.com", "firstname": "Ada", "jobtitle": "CTO" }`. Returns the created or updated contact with its id. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/crm/contacts#endpoint?spec=POST-/crm/v3/objects/contacts)
